senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָדַר; cmp. גִּדְרָה s. v. גּוֹדְרוֹת)enclosure, pen, fold; herd, flock. Ohol. VIII, 1 ע׳ בהמה וכ׳ clean or unclean beasts closely penned; Tosef. ib. IX, 1; [Ar. s. v. אדר, ed. Koh. s. v. אדורה, I, p. 39ᵃ, explains our w.: hide, v. עָדַר 1, a. עָדַד].
units: <cite ref="Yoma 34b">Yoma 34ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 70b">70ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 28a:11">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אחד מיוחד שבעֶדְרוֹ</he> ‘one’ (<cite ref="Numbers 28:4">Num. XXVIII, 4</cite>) means one singled out (the best) of its fold.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 24a:5">Bekh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>הנכנס לתוך עדרו וכ׳</he> if one enters his pen at night.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 5:3">Naz. V, 3</cite> <he>תצא ותרעה בע׳</he> let it go and be fed in the fold (as a profane animal).

<cite ref="Yoma 61b:10">Yoma 61ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>וכי עדרו משלח … וכי עדרו שורף</he> shall one send off his whole flock (of goats)?… shall one burn &c.?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲדָרִים</he>, <he>עֲדָרִין</he>.
Ex. R. s. 1 באין ע׳ ע׳ וכ׳ they came to their homes in flocks; א״ת עדי עדיים אלא עֶדְרֵי ע׳ read not (Ez. XVI, 7) ʿădi ʿădayim (choice attractions) but ‘edré ʿădarim (flocks after flocks).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:13:4">Cant. R. to II, 13</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 59:5">Is. LIX, 5</cite>) <he>להיכן הולכת … ויושבת ע׳ ע׳ במדבר</he> whither does banished Truth go (v. <cite ref="P00163"><he>עָדַר</he></cite>)? She goes and sits down in groups (of eremites) in the desert; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:1">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 357:1">Yalk. Is. 357</cite>; a. fr.—
Tosef. Eduy. III, 2 נוחרין היו עֲדָרוֹת וכ׳ they stabbed entire herds in the camp. (v., however, עָרוֹד).—מִגְדַּל עֵדֶר (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Migdal Eder (Fold Tower), between Bethlehem and Jerusalem.
